modules.name: European Expansion
modules.note: Use the green side of the goal board; some new goals don't work on the blue side.

steps.text: Shuffle the European bird and bonus cards into their decks; mix in the extra eggs, food and goal tiles
Shuffle the bird deck beside the bird tray; fill the tray with {n} faceup birds
All food and egg tokens in the supply
Toss the food dice into the birdfeeder
Goal board: green side (1st/2nd/3rd place) or blue side (1 point per item)
Shuffle the goal tiles; {n} random tiles, random side up, on the goal board
European reference tile next to the goal board
Shuffle the bonus cards into a deck
Give the Automa {n} action cubes of one color
Shuffle the Automa deck (remove Automubon Society unless playing expert); round tracker card beside it
Reveal a bonus card for the Automa first; redraw Breeding Manager, Backyard Birder, or any card without a %
End-of-round Goal Scoring card, Round 1 up, beside the Round 1 goal
Choose the Automa difficulty level
Each player: a player mat and {n} action cubes of one color
Deal each player {n} birds, 2 bonus cards and 5 food (one of each)
Keep up to 5 birds, discarding 1 food for each bird kept
Keep 1 bonus card, discard the other
Action cubes stay on the row you used until end-of-round scoring
Moving your cube right to left activates brown powers in that row; each is optional
Random first player takes the first-player token; play is clockwise
You always go first
Each turn: play a bird, gain food, lay eggs, or draw birds
